verdict.rationale: stagewise is documented as a desktop agentic IDE driven through chat, diff review and slash commands. Nothing in the evidence shows a headless or non-interactive mode for invoking the agent from scripts. The agent's own shell access, and a community mention of signing up via a CLI, are different capabilities and earn no credit for scripted agent runs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the agent non-interactively in scripts for workflow automation
